# VirtualFileSystemMount

A run a file system is mounted into.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `type` | [`VirtualFileSystemMountType`](virtual-file-system-mount-type.md) | The kind of run it is mounted into. |
| `associatedId` | `uuid` | The run's id. |
| `location` | `string` | The path it is mounted at inside the run. |
| `mountTime` | `datetime` | When it was mounted (UTC). |

## Example

```json
{
  "type": "CapsuleProcess",
  "associatedId": "3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4e6b-9c7d-2a1b0c9d8e7f",
  "location": "...",
  "mountTime": "2026-10-26T12:00:00.0000000Z"
}
```

## Where it's used

- Inside [`VirtualFileSystem`](virtual-file-system.md)
